title: Great Tour
text:
There are two options that you may have to decide upon arrival.  Boat first and then winery or  winery first and then boat ride back.     We did the boat first.   The boat is small and moves a lot when the wind blows as this a sailing experience.    Anyone who gets seasick easily should pick a different tour.    You may want to ask if one direction is better than the other based upon the wind conditions as our version was more upwind and the other option appeared to be more of a downwind experience which I felt would have been more pleasant.
